unit.note: shared/tests/test_update_marketplace_freshness.py (4 new tests) + the 3 pre-existing marketplace-related test files (test_installer_shell_scripts.py, test_update_marketplace_autoinstall.py, test_marketplace_excludes_python_version.py) — 28/28 passing after the fix. Full shared/tests suite additionally run via F0 (see below).

integration.reason: not cross_component framework machinery (merge/churn/event-log resolver, hooks fan-out, pipeline validators, campaign drain) — a single installer script's freshness check

e2e.reason: no browser surface; scripts/update-marketplace.sh is a local installer script

surface_verification.justification: small complexity, no touches_io_boundary/UI risk flag raised by classify_complexity.py — F0.5 is advisory-only at this tier. Behavior verified instead via 2 tests executing the REAL shipped freshness-check block (extracted verbatim, not a hand copy) via bash subprocess against isolated real git repos, covering the stale-clone-gets-synced and already-fresh-clone-left-alone cases.

behaviors.behavior: the freshness check runs unconditionally after Step 1, not only inside the SSH-fallback branch
a clone lagging origin/main's true tip (the reported race — a file landed just ahead of the sync) is hard-synced before any file copy
a clone already at the remote's tip is left alone (no false action, no needless network op)
an unreachable remote degrades the check instead of aborting the whole sync under set -euo pipefail
